_source: All values are FishSol-v2.1.ahk 1440p (2560x1440), label DoMouseMove2 (line 4045+). Line numbers in the _source fields refer to that file. 1080p/768p branches ignored. Only values were transcribed; no code was copied.

fishing._source: rod click L4565-4568 (MouseMove 1161,1124; Sleep 30; click; sleep 300). bite pixel L4579 (1536,1119)=0xFFFFFF exact. park mouse L4581 (1263,1177), sleep 50 L4582. bar color sample L4584 (1261,1033). normal strip L4664 PixelSearch 1043,1033 -> 1519,1058 tol 5. advanced strip L4639 row y=1033 x 1043..1519 tol 5, extend tol 10 L4647, threshold default 25 L62, click then sleep 25. minigame cap L4633 (9000 ms). after loop L4671-4675: sleep 300, move 1457,491, sleep 700, click, sleep 300. fishing failsafe L4591 (31 s, default L60) clicks 1690,1224 / 1523,649 / 1457,491 / 1163,1126 with 300 ms gaps (L4592-4605). pathing failsafe L4614 (61 s, default L61). strip rows/stride, minigamePollMs, poll and pre-click values are Vesper choices. FishSol PixelSearches the whole rect; Vesper grabs the strip once per pass with BitBlt (StripGrab) and tests the rows in code, so stride 1 = every pixel. A per-pixel PixelGetColor scan measured ~5.6 ms/px on the dev PC, far too slow.

reel._note: 2026 reel UI (lossless captures 2026-10-25): bar frame y 1030/1055, inside x 1042..1517; arrow base line y 1025; colours change per fish/light so none are stored. Used unless General.legacyReel=1.

result._note: Card after the reel (recording 2026-10-25): a miss shows 'Fishing Failed' / 'The fish is gone...' (it slides up, so the rect is tall). Used for the stop summary's caught / got away counts.

panelTitle._note: The fishing panel's 'Fishing' title (OCR). No panel and no Fish button before a cast = not at the fishing spot.

fishButton._note: The panel's Fish / Exit button under the rod click. Before casting, wait (OCR) until it reads Fish: after a catch or a miss it shows up late.

sell._source: daily reward check L4165 (PixelSearch 1228,879 -> 1331,904 color 0x7ffd90 tol 3; up to 3 tries), claim click L4167 (1280,895), close click L4171 (1890,527), 200 ms gaps. camera zoom L4182-4190: 80x WheelUp (25 ms), sleep 500, 35x WheelDown (25 ms), sleep 300. shop dialog clicks L4232-4238: (1308,1073) clicked twice 50 ms apart then 200, (1289,1264) after 200, then 800. sell loop L4244-4281 (VIP copy L4346-4385, same values): sleep 3000, item (1117,550) 200/200, sell-all (904,1080) or selected (700,1078) 200/500, shop-loaded pixel (593,795)=0x999999 timeout 5000 else close click (1945,355) after 200, sleep 50, confirm (1002,831) 200/1000, more-to-sell check PixelSearch 1027,595 -> 1183,604 white tol 3 (not found = stop), max rounds = fishingLoopCount default 15 (L15). shop close L4285 (1958,361) 200/200. Pre-route reset (Esc, R, Enter, menu clicks) is Input.ResetToSpawn. Grid rows/stride for the rect checks are Vesper choices (FishSol uses PixelSearch).

more._note: white of the first tile (its name / picture). Rows 568..612: at 16:10 the shop stretches but its tiles stay square, so the name sat above the old rows 595..604 and every sell read the list as empty (live 1920x1200, 2026-11-11)

craft._source: FishSol-v2.1.ahk RunForcedRespawnAction 1440p branch (VIP variant, 1440p branch: dialog L1961-1967, Lucky item L1974, qty box L1982, confirm L1990, Speed item L2001, Speed confirm L2017, unmapped L1978/L1994, close L2028; the non-VIP copy from L2304 has the same values). Values only. Shop dialog: click (1308,1073) twice 50 ms apart, sleep 200, click (870,1264), sleep 800. Per-potion item click (Lucky 1126,543 / Speed 1370,543) is replaced by the calibrated fisher_buy_<potion>; quantity box (1490,674) = fisher_qty; FishSol pastes the amount with the clipboard, Vesper types it; (1500,820)/(1490,820) = fisher_confirm. FishSol also clicks (784,1069) between the item and the quantity box and (1675,524) after the confirm: purpose unknown, NOT used (listed in unmapped for the manual check). Shop close: sleep 800, move (1945,355), sleep 300, click, sleep 300. 300 ms gaps between steps. Cauldron timings are Vesper choices (CraftTask statics).
